notes: ABox revision on direct_subsidiary_of (functional, subproperty of the transitive subsidiary_of): Lucasfilm's parent company becomes Sony. 'Parent company' means the owning company (the Walt Disney Company, not the studio division in between). Related asks whether Lucasfilm and Pixar have the same parent (stored in Disney's own description of its studios); caveat: it compares two ownership facts, a kind rated derived elsewhere. Derived: shared ultimate owner with Columbia Pictures ('ultimately owned', since Columbia's immediate owner is Sony Pictures Entertainment), the parent's country, and an application about an indirect stake. The indeterminate question asks who ultimately owns the Star Wars franchise. Unrelated near: who owns Pixar.
